classes.name: ARBs
classes.description: Losartan, valsartan, irbesartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, candesartan, azilsartan (Edarbi); single-agent tablets (combinations with HCTZ or amlodipine are alternatives only if listed separately). Sacubitril/valsartan (Entresto) is heart failure and out of scope.
classes.plainDescription: A daily blood pressure pill, often used when an ACE inhibitor causes cough.

classes.name: Calcium channel blockers

classes.name: Beta blockers
classes.description: Metoprolol tartrate/succinate, carvedilol IR/CR, atenolol, bisoprolol, nebivolol (Bystolic), propranolol IR/ER, labetalol, nadolol.
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill that slows the heart and lowers blood pressure.

classes.name: Thiazide diuretics
classes.plainDescription: A daily water pill for blood pressure.

records.verificationNote: Searched PDL text for hydrochlorothiazide, chlorthalidone, indapamide, metolazone and the 'diuretic' headings (pp.5-88). Only combination products appear (ACE/diuretic p.16; ARB/diuretic p.16; atenolol/chlorthalidone and metoprolol/HCTZ p.33; Edarbyclor p.16). The class description lists single agents only, so combinations are not alternatives. noCoveredAgent is set because no single-agent member is on the PDL; this is NOT a nonformulary finding (the PDL says it is a subset of the formulary). Hydrochlorothiazide is a reference pick only. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: reversed noCoveredAgent. Single-agent thiazides are absent from the PDL, and the PDL states it is only a subset of the formulary (p.5), so absence is not exclusion. Standard generic hydrochlorothiazide kept as the pick, no PDL PA applies. Web search found no citable Texas formulary line for it; confirm in the VDP Formulary Drug Search.]
